problem:
The function $f(x,y)$ is defined as 

$$
f(x,y)=\frac{{e}^{y}}{\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x}.
$$

Evaluate this function at the point $(\frac{1}{2},1).$

activity_context.topic_title: The Domain of a Multivariable Function

examples.problem:
The function $f(x,y)$ is defined as 

$$
f(x,y) = y^2 - \log_3(x - 7).
$$

Evaluate this function at the point $(10,3).$
examples.worked_solution:
To evaluate our multivariable function at the point $(10,3),$ we substitute $x = 10$ and $y = 3$ into the function expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(10,3) & =({y}^{2}-{log}_{3}⁡(x-7)){|}_{(10,3)} \\  & ={3}^{2}-{log}_{3}⁡(10-7) \\  & =9-{log}_{3}⁡(3) \\  & =9-1 \\  & =8.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(10,3)=8.$
